result.topic_en: Gauss explains how to derive the hypergeometric transformation F(θ, n+θ, n+1, ff) = (1−ff)^{−θ} F(θ, 1−θ, n+1, −ff/(1−ff)) by expanding the right side in powers of ff and comparing coefficients, illustrated with the coefficient of f^6, which is evaluated by the Gauss summation formula for F(−3, θ, n+1, 1).
result.transcription:
290
Die Ableitung der Gleichung
$F(\theta, n+\theta, n+1, ff) = (1-ff)^{-\theta} F(\theta, 1-\theta, n+1, -\frac{ff}{1-ff})$
geschieht für diesen Zweck am passendsten,
indem man die einzelnen Glieder des zweiten Theils
nach Potenzen von ff entwickelt, und alles was
einerlei Potenz von ff enthält zusammenfasst
wodurch die Gleichheit mit dem betreffenden
Gliede des ersten Theils leicht erkannt wird.
Es ist z. B. das Glied des ersten Theils welches
$f^6$ enthält
$\frac{\theta.\theta+1.\theta+2}{1.2.3} \frac{n+\theta.n+\theta+1.n+\theta+2}{n+1.n+2.n+3} . f^6$
während aus dem zweiten Theile hervorgeht
$\frac{\theta.\theta+1.\theta+2}{1.2.3} f^6$
$- \frac{\theta+1.\theta+2}{1.2} . \frac{\theta.1-\theta}{1.n+1} . f^6$
$+ \frac{\theta+2}{1} . \frac{\theta.\theta+1}{1.2} . \frac{1-\theta.2-\theta}{n+1.n+2} f^6$
$- \frac{\theta.\theta+1.\theta+2}{1.2.3} . \frac{1-\theta.2-\theta.3-\theta}{n+1.n+2.n+3} f^6$
$= \frac{\theta.\theta+1.\theta+2}{1.2.3} . f^6 . F(-3, \theta, n+1, 1)$
$= \frac{\theta.\theta+1.\theta+2}{1.2.3} f^6 \frac{\Pi n . \Pi(n+2+\theta)}{\Pi(n+3) \Pi(n+\theta-1)} = \frac{\theta.\theta+1.\theta+2}{1.2.3} \frac{n+\theta.n+\theta+1.n+\theta+2}{n+1.n+2.n+3}$

methods.what: Quadratic-type transformation of the hypergeometric series: F(θ, n+θ, n+1, x²) expressed through (1−x²)^{−θ} F(θ, 1−θ, n+1, −x²/(1−x²))
Proof method: expand each term of the right side in powers of ff, collect equal powers and compare coefficients with the left side
methods.quote:

methods.what: The collected f^6 coefficient from the right side equals a terminating hypergeometric series F(−3, θ, n+1, 1)
Gauss summation formula F(α,β,γ,1) = Π(γ−1)Π(γ−α−β−1)/(Π(γ−α−1)Π(γ−β−1)), applied to F(−3, θ, n+1, 1)
